unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Functional: notify the user when status changes.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Non-functional: don't lose the message; a few seconds delay is okay.
unseen.vi: Non-functional: đừng mất tin; delay vài giây được.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: I'd draw an API layer and a worker pool.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Why not call FCM from the request?
unseen.vi: Sao không gọi FCM ngay trong request?

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The downside is timeouts. I'd pick a queue because… retries.
unseen.vi: Nhược: timeout. Chọn queue vì retry.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The bottleneck is the worker count at peak.

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Notifications: push when an order ships. 15 minutes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Let's start with requirements. What's the scale?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'd sketch this first. Clients talk to an API, store goes in a queue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I'd pick a queue because we can retry. The downside is delay.
dialogue.vi: Chọn queue vì retry được. Nhược: delay.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This breaks when workers stall. I'd cache user device tokens.
dialogue.vi: Vỡ khi worker đứng. Cache device token.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I haven't operated this in prod. I'd rather keep it simple — at-least-once plus idempotency.
dialogue.vi: Chưa ops. Giữ đơn giản — at-least-once + idempotent.

aiPrompt.scenario: 15-minute mock: URL shortener OR order notifications. Interrupt on Kafka/exactly-once. No bluffing.
aiPrompt.system: You are a software interviewer at a foreign company. Speak natural interview English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra interview English so the learner practices listening. Interrupt with a follow-up. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Let's start with requirements; I'd sketch this first; I'd pick X because…; This breaks when…; I haven't operated this in prod. Ask about their real experience. Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: 15-minute mock: URL shortener OR order notifications. Interrupt on Kafka/exactly-once. No bluffing.
